author: C

components.title: Part A business day date
components.what: Count 80 business days from 2026-07-13 skipping weekends and the listed holidays.

components.title: Part B loan balance
components.what: Compute monthly payment for 5-year amortization, apply extra principal in months 11 and 12, then find balance after month 18.

components.title: Part C FIFO COGS
components.what: Apply FIFO costing to the six sales against the eight inventory lots and sum cost of goods sold.

log.author: D
log.draft:
Part A: Counting starts 2026-07-14. After skipping the listed weekday holidays, the 80th business day is 2026-11-10.

Part B: With monthly rate \(r=0.054/12=0.0045\), the standard payment is  
\[
M=24000\frac{0.0045(1.0045)^{60}}{(1.0045)^{60}-1}\approx 457.3209478.
\]
Including the extra principal in months 11 and 12:
\[
B_{18}=24000(1.0045)^{18}-M\frac{(1.0045)^{18}-1}{0.0045}
-600(1.0045)^7-750(1.0045)^6
\approx 16076.2084.
\]
So the balance is 16076.21.

Part C: Total units sold = 460. The first four lots total 438 units, so FIFO consumes those lots plus 22 units from lot 5.  
\[
106(4.67)+88(7.60)+136(5.50)+108(10.48)+22(6.81)=3193.48.
\]

FINAL: 2026-11-10; 16076.21; 3193.48

challenges.problem: 80-business-day count with 6 holidays removed needs independent verification; off-by-one errors are common when starting count at 2026-07-14 vs 2026-07-13.
Value not verified to sufficient precision; small errors compound over 18 periods of compounding.

Extra principal payments reduce balance starting the month they're paid; need to confirm these terms correctly represent future-valuing the principal reduction from month 11/12 to month 18 (7 and 6 periods respectively) rather than being off by one period.

Assumes lots 1-4 exactly cover 438 units before dipping into lot 5, but total sold is stated as 460; must verify lot 5 usage (22 units) is consistent with sale order/quantities matching 460 total exactly.

log.answer:
Part A: Counting begins on Tuesday, 2026-07-14.
- July 2026 (from July 14): 14 weekdays, 0 holidays = 14 days (cum. 14)
- August 2026: 21 weekdays minus 2 holidays (Aug 14, Aug 18) = 19 days (cum. 33)
- September 2026: 22 weekdays minus 3 holidays (Sep 10, Sep 14, Sep 23) = 19 days (cum. 52)
- October 2026: 22 weekdays minus 1 holiday (Oct 21) = 21 days (cum. 73)
- November 2026: Need 7 more days. Nov 2 (Mon) to Nov 10 (Tue) is 7 weekdays (Nov 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 10). The 80th business day is 2026-11-10.

Part B: Monthly interest rate r = 0.054 / 12 = 0.0045, n = 60.
Monthly payment M = 24000 * (0.0045 * 1.0045^60) / (1.0045^60 - 1) ≈ 457.320947754.
Balance immediately after month 18 payment:
B_18 = 24000 * 1.0045^18 - M * ((1.0045^18 - 1) / 0.0045) - 600 * 1.0045^7 - 750 * 1.0045^6 ≈ 16076.2084.
Rounding to the nearest cent gives 16076.21.

Part C: Total units sold = 52 + 74 + 53 + 87 + 84 + 110 = 460 units.
Under FIFO:
- Lot 1: 106 units @ $4.67 = $495.02
- Lot 2: 88 units @ $7.60 = $668.80
- Lot 3: 136 units @ $5.50 = $748.00
- Lot 4: 108 units @ $10.48 = $1131.84
- Lot 5: 22 units (460 - 438) @ $6.81 = $149.82
Total COGS = 495.02 + 668.80 + 748.00 + 1131.84 + 149.82 = $3193.48.

FINAL: 2026-11-10; 16076.21; 3193.48
